This comedian was recently interviewed by Variety magazine to promote his new film Misty Green, and was asked about his views on the president.

Variety pointed out that Rock was one of the few celebrities who predicted Trump's victory as early as 2016—but that doesn't mean the comedian agrees with his ideology.

Rock said: "I'm not his fan. But the funny thing is, when a person gets one thing right, it seems to erase all his other faults. The news is fake—he got that right."

Although Rock did not elaborate further, he did touch on another sensitive topic: Will Smith and that infamous slap.

Variety asked Rock how he felt about that moment four years ago.

He shared: "Hey, man. You know, to simply answer your question, I wish it never happened. The world is crazy. We pass homeless people every day, and now all kinds of crazy things are happening. Me being in a bad mood doesn't mean anything—that doesn't matter."

Rock revealed that while he may not host the Oscars again ("to be honest, my time might be over"), he would return to the ceremony under certain conditions.

The comedian said: "I won't be nominated. The only condition for me to go back is if I'm nominated, and I won't be nominated. That's fine. We'll see when the time comes. Let's manage expectations first."
